defects.repro: In isolated Chromium, mock GET /api/chat/status as configured:false; open Account > About and refresh local status.
defects.expected: The About connection identity should remain consistent with the false/unavailable status or say it is unknown.
defects.actual: About shows “OpenCode · MiMo V2.5 (configured)” while the diagnostics report shows provider “Not connected”, model “Unavailable”, configured:false.
